photos.alt: Old hardware store interior with tall dark wooden pigeonhole shelves, hand-numbered bins of small parts, iron gear wheels hung on the side, and daylight pouring in through large paned windows.
photos.colors: dark brown wood, warm grey, window white, amber
photos.notes: Natural-light photo of an old parts store, titled 'Old Hardware Store' on Pexels, sharp and unfiltered (replaces a heavily oil-paint-filtered B&W). Only hand-painted bin numbers, no brand signage. The big window on the left is bright, so put the headline panel or an ink/cream wash on the left third, or frame it as a catalogue plate. Warm browns sit well with the forest-green/brass palette.

photos.alt: Several old hammers and other hand tools laid out on dark, weathered wooden boards.
photos.colors: dark brown, steel grey, yellow and red accents
photos.notes: Moody flat lay with a yellow-handled hammer as the colour pop. Works as a card thumbnail (crop square) or a wide strip; darken-friendly for text.

photos.alt: Four metal combination wrenches arranged in a row on a rustic wooden board.
photos.notes: Clean, symmetrical, bright metal on warm wood. Great for the hand-tools department card at any crop.

photos.alt: Close-up from above of open tins of paint in lavender, orange-red, teal, yellow and deep blue.
photos.notes: Saturated, tight macro of paint tins. The one bright colour hit on the page: use it for the Paint department and the paint-matching service.

photos.alt: Dark compartment bins sorted with nuts, bolts, washers and small fittings, with a few yellow connectors.
photos.notes: Looks like a real fastener wall, exactly the nuts-and-bolts-by-the-pound feel. Works as a wide banner or square card.

photos.alt: A sunlit wooden workshop with a cluttered workbench and hand tools lined up on shelves above it.
photos.notes: Portrait, warm and golden. Lovely for the "ask Walt" how-to section or the local-pride blurb; crop to landscape around the bench and shelves.

photos.alt: A row of vintage hand saws with worn wooden handles, blades upright, resting side by side on a wooden rack against a grey wall.
photos.notes: Wide, shallow depth of field, very heritage. Good as a thin banner for the hand-tools section.

photos.alt: Close-up of a hand marking a timber plank with a pencil against a yellow tape measure.
photos.notes: Faceless hands-only shot. Yellow tape gives a clear accent against the cream paper look.

photos.alt: Close-up of a well-used cordless drill with a nail in its chuck, with more drills blurred behind it, against warm wood.
photos.notes: Shallow focus with warm orange blur; the drill sits left of centre, so keep the crop biased left. Good for the power-tools card and the tool-rental table.

photos.alt: A row of yellow-painted garden tools (two hoes, a rake, a shovel, a pitchfork and a twig broom) standing against a dark wooden wall.
photos.notes: Graphic and flat, almost a print-ad layout. Mustard yellow matches the brass accents. Works at any crop.

photos.alt: Stacks of sawn timber planks on pallets at an outdoor lumber yard, under a covered shed.
photos.colors: honey timber, gravel grey, overcast sky
photos.notes: Honest working yard, soft overcast light. Good for the Lumber department and the yard-delivery note.

photos.alt: Close-up of a locksmith's hands filing a key blank clamped in a small vise, with a red handle and fine metal shavings in the air.
photos.colors: soft blue-grey stripes, steel, skin tones, red accent
photos.notes: Faceless hands-only key-cutting shot in warm daylight, no brand names (replaces a wall of key blanks whose maker names were legible). Portrait; the action sits in the lower middle, so keep the crop biased down for a landscape card. Good for the key-cutting service panel.

photos.alt: A wooden tool wall with hand planes, chisels, screwdrivers, saws and pliers hung in tidy rows.
photos.colors: honey wood, white wall, red and blue handles
photos.notes: Second hero candidate: bright, orderly, instantly "proper tools". Landscape, but detailed, so use it as a plate or under a wash, not behind raw headline text.

photos.alt: A weathered wooden wall cabinet holding old wooden hand planes, chisels and a marking gauge, with two small drawers underneath, against a plain pale wall.
photos.colors: weathered brown, tan, pale grey wall
photos.notes: Heritage tool cabinet, portrait, clean pale background and no text (replaces a Thai hardware-shop photo with legible Thai cartons). Reads as a catalogue plate; use as a tall side plate on the department index or the local-pride blurb. Plenty of calm wall space on both sides for captions.

photos.alt: A grey-haired man in glasses and a maroon polo shirt concentrates on fine woodwork with a small fretsaw, a plank clamped on the bench in front of him.
photos.colors: maroon, warm pine, grey hair, red and blue textile behind
photos.notes: Human face for the "ask Walt" how-to tips; portrait, bright daylight, no logos or text (replaces a shopkeeper photo with a prominent Nike swoosh on his vest). He looks down at his work, so it reads as 'showing you how'. Crop to the head, hands and plank for a square or 4:5 card.
